reports.rationale: Client's working table of DIAN Form 220 (Certificado de Ingresos y Retenciones): one row per person, header row 2, columns 'Campo 24'..'Campo 60' = casillas 24-60 of the current form (casilla numbering confirmed against the CIR 2024 sheet labels: 36 salaries ... 46 'Otros pagos', 50 pensions, 52 total gross, 53-58 contributions, 59 average income, 60 withholding). Casilla 35 appears as 'Textbox113' (05001); note Campo 34 (department code) also holds '05001' rather than a 2-digit department code - format point for the cross-checker; an extra 'Textbox100' column (=1 on every row) has no evidenced meaning. Tax year 2025 (Campo 30 = 2025-01-01, Campo 31 = 2025-12-31, Campo 32 issue date 2026-03-31), place MEDELLIN. Only 34 of 651 numbered rows carry values (values-only copy of an .xlsm). VERIFIED POPULATION: all 34 are PENSIONERS - their personnel numbers ('pern') and documents (Campo 25) all appear in the Acumulados tab of the ConsolidadoCCT file with pensioner wage types (62151-62154 retirement payments, 21154/21155 pensioner AFP/income tax), and none appears among the 261 active employees of the Sep-2026 G2N. For all 34 the whole income is in Campo 46 'Otros pagos' (sum 2,731,679,473), casilla 50 'Pensiones de jubilacion, vejez o invalidez' is 0, casilla 52 'Total ingresos brutos' is 0 and 53-59 are 0; Campo 60 (withholding) is non-zero for 23. This is a potential CONFLICT with the casilla 50 / casilla 52 rules of the draft - for the CO-DIAN-004 cross-checker. Right-hand columns ('pern', 'len', 'check pern', 'putn co', 'cruce con el req', 'VALOR RETENCION A INCLUI', 'DIF') are client control columns. CO-DIAN-005 listed because Formato 2276 carries the same per-beneficiary annual concepts (pensions numeral N21, other payments N17, withholding N29); for 2276 this sheet is cross-reference evidence only. Medium: direct for 220 but evidences only the pensioner population and only casillas 24-35, 46 and 60 with non-zero data.
reports.hypothesis_check: Confirmed as direct for CO-DIAN-004 (one row per person, Campo 24..60 = casillas). Refined: the populated rows are pensioners only, tax year 2025, not active employees.

Horizontal gross-to-net, one row per employee (261 + GRAND TOTAL, header row 12), one column per wage type, then Gross Salary, deductions (EPS 2554, AFP 2556, FSP 2553, income tax 2552, AFC 25800-25806, FVOL 2581x/25823, union fees, loans), Total Deductions, Net Pay, non-cash informative WTs, SS/parafiscal bases (64990-64996, 63011) and employer contributions (2560 ARL, 2564 EPS, 2567 AFP, 25110 CCF, 25111 ICBF, 25112 SENA). HYPOTHESIS OVERTURNED on 'all runs combined': the title block reads Payroll id REF-P201-090, report generation date 2026-09-16 - the SAME payroll id and date as the round-1 Vertical G2N Dynamic - and a cell-by-cell check shows all 31,320 employee x wage-type values equal the round-1 Vertical G2N (gross equal for 260 of 261 employees). It is therefore the same single run in horizontal layout, not a consolidation of all September runs; it cannot evidence the 'all runs' total of Form 350 or of the monthly NE document. Its Gross Salary / Total Deductions / Net Pay are the reference the client uses in 'Validacion netos' (columns K/L/M = these values). Segment code in column A, then positional fields in B..X (no header row; the profile's 'headers' are the first ENC record). Settlement period 2026-09-01..2026-09-30, generation 2026-09-24, payment date (FEP) 2026-09-22. Field order inside each segment follows the NIE XSD order (see segment_codes). This is direct evidence of the NIE fields the client populates, their formats (dates yyyy-mm-dd, amounts with 2 decimals, codes 01/00/13/47/02) and of empty fields (FechaRetiro, CUNE slot, Redondeo). CAVEAT: masking digit-substituted some AMOUNTS - REC 'Sueldo' never equals the G2N 'Salary Assigned' (0/261), ITE salary equals the masked Sueldo token in 206/261 blocks, TOT values do not reconcile with the segment amounts and 52 'DeduccionesTotal' values carry a leading zero; ENC Consecutivo (col K) no longer matches the number suffix in col L. Use the file for structure/format/coverage; take amounts from the G2N.
reports.hypothesis_check: Confirmed: segment-based NE document file, 261 ENC blocks, DIRECT evidence for CO-DIAN-001.

segment_codes._note: Meaning inferred from (a) the Mapping sheet (WT -> segment_position), (b) WT descriptions in the Acumulados tab, (c) the positional content of Monthly_fixed, and (d) the element order of the DIAN NIE XSD as listed in the CO-DIAN-001 v1.1 draft. Items marked 'inferred' rest on position order only.
segment_codes.ENC: Document header: B literal 'NominaIndividual'; C FechaIngreso (NIE002); D FechaRetiro (NIE003, empty); E/F FechaLiquidacionInicio/Fin (NIE004/005); G TiempoLaborado in days (NIE006); H FechaGen of period (NIE008); I CodigoTrabajador (NIE009); J Prefijo 'EC' (NIE010); K Consecutivo (NIE011); L Numero = prefix+consecutive (NIE012); M/N/O generation country/department/municipality (NIE013-015); P Idioma 'es' (NIE016); Q Version literal (NIE022); R Ambiente '1' (NIE023); S TipoXML '102' (NIE202); T empty (CUNE slot - inferred, CUNE computed by the provider); U FechaGen (NIE026); V HoraGen (NIE027); W PeriodoNomina '5' monthly (NIE029); X TipoMoneda 'COP' (NIE030).
segment_codes.EMI: Employer (Empleador): corporate name, NIT, DV, country, department, municipality, address (NIE032-NIE038); natural-person name slots empty; column F repeats the corporate name (position meaning not evidenced).
segment_codes.REC: Employee (Trabajador): TipoTrabajador '01', SubTipoTrabajador '00', AltoRiesgoPension, TipoDocumento '13', NumeroDocumento, surnames/names, place of work country/department/municipality/address, SalarioIntegral true/false, TipoContrato, Sueldo, CodigoTrabajador (NIE041-NIE063).
segment_codes.PAG: Payment (Pago): Forma '1', Metodo '47', Banco (name), TipoCuenta, NumeroCuenta (NIE064-NIE068).
segment_codes.ITE: Devengados/Basico: ITE_1 DiasTrabajados (NIE069), ITE_2 SueldoTrabajado (NIE070) - WT 62100, 62101, 62140, 62141, 65820.
segment_codes.ETR: Devengados/Transporte: ETR_1 AuxilioTransporte (NIE071, WT 62520), ETR_2 ViaticoManuAlojS (NIE072, per diems 62805-62809, 62810, 62820, 62821), ETR_3 ViaticoManuAlojNS (NIE073, no WT mapped).
segment_codes.EVC: Vacaciones/VacacionesComunes: EVC_4 Pago (NIE112) - WT 79401 Annual leave payout.
segment_codes.EVA: Vacaciones/VacacionesCompensadas: EVA_2 Pago (NIE116) - WT 79403 Vacations compensated in cash.
segment_codes.EBN: Bonificaciones: EBN_1 BonificacionS (NIE139) - 62150 Vacation bonus, 62208-62210, 62118, 62228, 65838; EBN_2 BonificacionNS (NIE140) - awards, allowances, 62229, 62122 etc.
segment_codes.EAX: Auxilios: EAX_1 AuxilioS (NIE141) - 62133, 62225; EAX_2 AuxilioNS (NIE142) - 62523 transport CLA, 62700, 62221, health/life insurance informative WTs etc.
segment_codes.EOT: OtrosConceptos: EOT_3 ConceptoNS (NIE148) - stock awards, retirement/pension payments 62151-62155, 62216, 65821 expatriation package, loans paid 67010/67040/67090, 1910 etc.
segment_codes.EVO: Single-value earnings (inferred from XSD order Dotacion/ApoyoSost/Teletrabajo/BonifRetiro/Indemnizacion): EVO_2 ApoyoSost (NIE157) - 62148/62149 Internship pay; EVO_4 BonifRetiro (NIE159) - 62203; EVO_5 Indemnizacion (NIE160) - 62180/62181.
segment_codes.EBO: BonoEPCTVs: EBO_4 PagoAlimentacionNS (NIE154) - 65813 Meal allowance inf.
segment_codes.ECO: Comisiones/PagosTerceros/Anticipos group (inferred from XSD order): ECO_2 PagoTercero accrued (NIE193) - 65802 Foncoltabaco company contribution, 65809 optical; ECO_3 Anticipo accrued (NIE194) - 61100 Weekly advance, 61101, 61150, 61200.
segment_codes.ELI: Licencias/LicenciaMP: ELI_4 Pago (NIE131) - 79406 maternity, 79407 paternity (mapped; no rows in Sep-2026).
segment_codes.ELR: Licencias/LicenciaR: ELR_4 Pago (NIE135) - 79405, 79414, 79418, 79419, 79420 (mapped; no rows in Sep-2026).
segment_codes.EPR: Primas: EPR_2 Pago (NIE118) - 62211 Service legal bonus (mapped; no rows in Sep-2026).
segment_codes.EHE: Overtime/surcharge segment (e.g. 'EHE^HEN^...' line quoted in Validacion netos) - not present in Monthly_fixed.
segment_codes.ITS: Deducciones/Salud: ITS_1 Porcentaje '4' (NIE161), ITS_2 Deduccion (NIE163) - 2554 and pensioner EPS WTs.
segment_codes.SSP: Deducciones/FondoSP: SSP_2 DeduccionSP (NIE168) - 2553 and pensioner FSP WTs; subsistence positions not populated in Sep-2026.
segment_codes.SOT: Deducciones PagosTerceros/Anticipos/OtrasDeducciones (XSD order): SOT_1 PagoTercero (NIE195) - Foncoltabaco, pensioner associations, funeral, 21803; SOT_2 Anticipo (NIE196) - 21215 Legalization salary payment; SOT_3 OtraDeduccion (NIE197) - private health insurance, expat deductions, 1204, 21821.
segment_codes.SVA: Single-value deductions in XSD order: SVA_1 PensionVoluntaria (NIE198), SVA_2 RetencionFuente (NIE177) - 2552 and other tax WTs, SVA_3 AFC (NIE179), SVA_4 Cooperativa (NIE180) - 21617, SVA_5 EmbargoFiscal (NIE181) - garnishments, SVA_9 Deuda (NIE185) - housing/interest-free loan fees.
segment_codes.TOT: Document totals: positions 2/3/4 populated (Redondeo NIE186 empty). By XSD order these are DevengadosTotal (NIE187), DeduccionesTotal (NIE188), ComprobanteTotal (NIE189); but the Mapping assigns WT 26998 'Net salary (notional)' to TOT_03, so the position order must be confirmed (masked amounts do not allow a numeric check).
